scope: Read-only selection of whole-hour host/config groups containing observed players

real_history_replay.source: 31 samples captured from accepted DJ2 Core 0.3.7 lab

limits: Hour groups include idle and maintenance; mean/max are not active-only
Selection counts readings, never playtime or unique players
Limits apply before filtering; empty truncated result does not classify unread hours
Legacy or incomplete zero-online data stays unknown
No actual VPS measurement, capacity recommendation or lifecycle/job correlation in this scope
